previous_description: A distinct test type or environmental context under which a coverage target may be invoked, used to parameterize test design across different execution conditions (functional correctness, load behavior, security posture, regression state). Maps to environmental needs documented in IEEE 829-2008 test design specifications.
definition: A named test-design condition, classified by test type (functional, load, security, regression, smoke, exploratory), under which a TestCoverageTarget is to be exercised, optionally bound to a set of EnvironmentFactors that fix the concrete environment for that condition. It names the whole execution context. It does not name a single environmental variable or an input value.

distinguish_from.when: the element is a single concrete environmental variable and its value (e.g. 'Ubuntu 22.04', 'en-US', 'latency < 100ms'), not a named test context that groups such variables
the element states coverage criteria (pairwise, boundary-values, MC/DC) that must be met, possibly across several contexts, rather than defining one context
the variation is in the data fed to the target (an input field's equivalence classes), not in the type of test or the execution environment
the element classifies the expected result (success, timeout, validation-error), not the conditions under which the test runs

standard_reference: IEEE 829-2008 Test Design Specification – Approach refinements and Environmental needs (Level Test Plan §8.3.x Environmental needs)
code_evidence: Separate test suites or directories split by test type, such as tests/load, tests/security, tests/smoke, or pytest markers / JUnit @Tag('smoke'|'regression') used to select runs
CI pipeline jobs or matrix entries that run the same targets under named contexts, e.g. a 'load' job invoking k6/JMeter or a 'security' job invoking OWASP ZAP, each with its own environment variables

Test configuration profiles bundling environment settings per context, e.g. playwright.config projects, tox envs, or application-test-load.yml, that set OS, locale, network throttling or dependency versions

attribute_descriptions.name: description
attribute_descriptions.description: Free-text explanation of the execution condition this variation represents: its purpose, scope and how it differs from other contexts applied to the same target, such as 'peak-load run at 500 rps against staging'. Set it whenever the contextType alone does not identify the context uniquely.

notes: The contextType enum mixes test levels and kinds (smoke, regression, exploratory) with quality-attribute contexts (load, security). It lacks performance/stress, accessibility and compatibility. The environmentFactors attribute duplicates the references relationship, and EnvironmentFactor 'composes' ContextVariation conflicts with the direction of 'references'. Consider a name/label attribute. The duplicated self depends-on relationship should be deduplicated.
